title: Two Odd Ones Out
statement:
A list of `n` numbers (`n` is even) contains exactly two numbers that appear once; the two are different from each other. Every other number appears exactly twice, in any positions.

Print the two numbers that appear once, smaller first.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains the `n` numbers.

## Output
Print the two numbers separated by a space.

## Constraints
- `2 <= n <= 16000`, `n` is even
- `0 <= a_i <= 2^31 - 1`
